# pangolin_ai_budget (Resource)

Manages a spending cap of the AI gateway (Pangolin 1.26+), in USD or tokens per period. It applies to one AI provider, AI model, public inference resource, private inference resource, role or virtual API key, or to the whole organization when no scope is set. A scope holds one budget per unit and period.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap the organization at 500 USD a month.
resource "pangolin_ai_budget" "org" {
  amount = 500
  unit   = "usd"
}

# Cap one provider at 2 million tokens a day, report only.
resource "pangolin_ai_budget" "openai_daily" {
  provider_id = pangolin_ai_provider.openai.id
  amount      = 2000000
  unit        = "tokens"
  period      = "daily"
  enforcement = "soft"
}

# Cap one virtual API key.
resource "pangolin_ai_budget" "ci_key" {
  virtual_api_key_id = pangolin_virtual_api_key.ci.id
  amount             = 20
  unit               = "usd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `amount` (Number) The cap, in `unit`. Must be greater than zero.
- `unit` (String) `usd` or `tokens`.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `enforcement` (String) `hard` refuses requests over the cap, `soft` only reports it. Defaults to `hard`.
- `model_id` (Number) ID of the `pangolin_ai_model` the budget applies to. At most one scope attribute may be set; none means the whole organization.
- `period` (String) The reset period: `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `yearly` or `lifetime`. Defaults to `monthly`.
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the `pangolin_ai_provider` the budget applies to. At most one scope attribute may be set; none means the whole organization.
- `resource_id` (Number) ID of the public inference `pangolin_resource` the budget applies to. At most one scope attribute may be set; none means the whole organization.
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the `pangolin_role` the budget applies to. At most one scope attribute may be set; none means the whole organization.
- `site_resource_id` (Number) ID of the private inference `pangolin_site_resource` the budget applies to. At most one scope attribute may be set; none means the whole organization.
- `virtual_api_key_id` (String) ID of the `pangolin_virtual_api_key` the budget applies to. At most one scope attribute may be set; none means the whole organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The numeric budget ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an AI budget by its numeric ID.
terraform import pangolin_ai_budget.org <budget_id>
```
